items.title: Nvidia RTX 5090 shipment worth $470,000 goes missing in Brazilian airport

items.title: Official DLSS 5 running on unsupported games delivers up to 90% better performance than the leaked version
items.summary: Nvidia's latest DLSS Neural Renderer, extracted from NBA 2K27 (again), is being tested on unsupported games and shows up to a 90% performance gain over the previous NR model.
items.title_original: Official DLSS 5 running on unsupported games delivers up to 90% better performance than the leaked version
items.title_en: Official DLSS 5 running on unsupported games delivers up to 90% better performance than the leaked version
items.title_zh: 在不受支持的游戏上运行的官方 DLSS 5 性能比泄露版本提高了 90%
items.title_bilingual: 在不受支持的游戏上运行的官方 DLSS 5 性能比泄露版本提高了 90% / Official DLSS 5 running on unsupported games delivers up to 90% better performance than the leaked version
items.summary_zh: Nvidia 最新的 DLSS 神经渲染器（再次）从 NBA 2K27 中提取，正在不受支持的游戏上进行测试，与之前的 NR 模型相比，性能提升了 90%。

items.title: 300-plus local data center bans have only delayed just three US projects
items.summary: SemiAnalysis mapped more than 300 local data center moratoriums against the US pipeline and found only three projects actually delayed.

items.title_en: 300-plus local data center bans have only delayed just three US projects

items.title: Anthropic’s proposed AI safety bill only kicks in if 50 deaths or $1 billion in damages are on the line
items.summary: Anthropic's proposal requires evaluators to report any imminent risk to the Department of Commerce within 72 hours, after which the Department must present the evidence to a federal judge and await an order.
items.title_original: Anthropic’s proposed AI safety bill only kicks in if 50 deaths or $1 billion in damages are on the line
items.title_en: Anthropic’s proposed AI safety bill only kicks in if 50 deaths or $1 billion in damages are on the line
items.title_bilingual: Anthropic’s proposed AI safety bill only kicks in if 50 deaths or $1 billion in damages are on the line
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 的提案要求评估人员在 72 小时内向商务部报告任何迫在眉睫的风险，之后商务部必须向联邦法官提交证据并等待命令。

items.title: Researchers train AI to detect concealed handguns using Wi-Fi signals
items.summary: Researchers have developed WiFireNet, an AI system that detects concealed handguns from Wi-Fi channel-state information, achieving 72.5% average precision in controlled indoor tests without cameras or metal detectors.
items.title_original: Researchers train AI to detect concealed handguns using Wi-Fi signals
items.title_en: Researchers train AI to detect concealed handguns using Wi-Fi signals
items.title_zh: 研究人员训练人工智能使用 Wi-Fi 信号检测隐藏的手枪
items.title_bilingual: 研究人员训练人工智能使用 Wi-Fi 信号检测隐藏的手枪 / Researchers train AI to detect concealed handguns using Wi-Fi signals
items.summary_zh: 研究人员开发了 WiFireNet，这是一种人工智能系统，可以从 Wi-Fi 通道状态信息中检测隐藏的手枪，在没有摄像头或金属探测器的受控室内测试中实现了 72.5% 的平均精度。
